```{ojs}
// Toggle: highlight selection (use explicit values for robust comparisons)
viewof vennOp = Inputs.radio(
  ["None", "A", "B", "Aᶜ", "Union", "Intersection"],
  { value: "None", label: "Highlight:" }
)


```

```{ojs}
//| label: fig-venn
//| fig-cap: Venn diagram of two events $A$ and $B$ inside the sample space $\Omega$.

venn = {
  const width = 480, height = 280;
  const pad = 18;

  const cxA = 190, cyA = 140, r = 90;   // circle A
  const cxB = 290, cyB = 140;           // circle B

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
    .style("background", "var(--plot-bg)")
    .style("color", "var(--plot-fg)");

  // Sample space Ω (bounding rectangle)
  const omega = svg.append("rect")
    .attr("x", pad).attr("y", pad)
    .attr("width", width - 2*pad).attr("height", height - 2*pad)
    .attr("rx", 10)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", "currentColor")
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.5);

  // Label Ω
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", pad + 8).attr("y", pad + 16)
    .text("Ω")
    .style("font-weight", 400)
    .style("font-size", "18px")
    .style("fill", "var(--plot-muted)");

  // Colors (CSS vars with fallbacks)
  const colA   = "var(--plot-series-1)";
  const colB   = "var(--plot-series-4)";
  const hilite = "var(--plot-fill-2)";
  const grid   = "var(--plot-grid)";

  // --- Defs: clips & mask for A^c ---
  const defs = svg.append("defs");

  defs.append("clipPath").attr("id", "clipA")
    .append("circle").attr("cx", cxA).attr("cy", cyA).attr("r", r);

  defs.append("clipPath").attr("id", "clipB")
    .append("circle").attr("cx", cxB).attr("cy", cyB).attr("r", r);

  // Mask for A^c: white keeps, black removes (subtract circle A from Ω rect)
  const m = defs.append("mask").attr("id", "maskAc");
  m.append("rect")
    .attr("x", pad).attr("y", pad)
    .attr("width", width - 2*pad).attr("height", height - 2*pad)
    .attr("rx", 10)
    .attr("fill", "white");
  m.append("circle")
    .attr("cx", cxA).attr("cy", cyA).attr("r", r)
    .attr("fill", "black");

  // Base sets (always lightly transparent)
  svg.append("circle")
    .attr("cx", cxA).attr("cy", cyA).attr("r", r)
    .attr("fill", colA).attr("fill-opacity", 0.4);

  svg.append("circle")
    .attr("cx", cxB).attr("cy", cyB).attr("r", r)
    .attr("fill", colB).attr("fill-opacity", 0.4);

  // Highlight layer
  if (vennOp === "A") {
    svg.append("circle")
      .attr("cx", cxA).attr("cy", cyA).attr("r", r)
      .attr("fill", hilite).attr("fill-opacity", 0.99);

  } else if (vennOp === "B") {
    svg.append("circle")
      .attr("cx", cxB).attr("cy", cyB).attr("r", r)
      .attr("fill", hilite).attr("fill-opacity", 0.99);

  } else if (vennOp === "Aᶜ") {
    // Draw Ω in orange, but masked to remove A
    svg.append("rect")
      .attr("x", pad).attr("y", pad)
      .attr("width", width - 2*pad).attr("height", height - 2*pad)
      .attr("rx", 10)
      .attr("fill", hilite).attr("fill-opacity", 0.99)
      .attr("mask", "url(#maskAc)");

  } else if (vennOp === "Union") {
    // A ∪ B: overlay both circles solid orange
    svg.append("circle")
      .attr("cx", cxA).attr("cy", cyA).attr("r", r)
      .attr("fill", hilite).attr("fill-opacity", 0.99);
    svg.append("circle")
      .attr("cx", cxB).attr("cy", cyB).attr("r", r)
      .attr("fill", hilite).attr("fill-opacity", 0.99);

  } else if (vennOp === "Intersection") {
    // A ∩ B: clip B by A (equivalently clip A by B)
    svg.append("g").attr("clip-path", "url(#clipA)")
      .append("circle")
      .attr("cx", cxB).attr("cy", cyB).attr("r", r)
      .attr("fill", hilite).attr("fill-opacity", 0.99);
  }

  // Labels A and B
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", cxA - 26).attr("y", cyA - 8)
    .text("A")
    .style("font-size", "14px")
    .style("font-weight", 600)
    .style("fill", "var(--plot-muted)");

  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", cxB + 22).attr("y", cyB - 8)
    .text("B")
    .style("font-size", "14px")
    .style("font-weight", 600)
    .style("fill", "var(--plot-muted)");

  // Subtle baseline
  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", pad).attr("x2", width - pad)
    .attr("y1", height - pad - 0.5).attr("y2", height - pad - 0.5)
    .attr("stroke", grid).attr("stroke-opacity", 0.2);

  return svg.node();
}

```
